subject: food-technology

moments.title: Silent Spring
moments.body:
Carson's book on synthetic pesticide use is widely credited with launching the modern environmental movement.

It accelerates the organic movement's public profile.
moments.takeaway: A single book transformed food production debates.

moments.title: IFOAM founded
moments.body: The International Federation of Organic Agriculture Movements (IFOAM) is established to coordinate standards.
moments.takeaway: Voluntary standards preceded national legal frameworks.

moments.title: USDA Organic seal in effect
moments.body: The National Organic Program standardises labelling in the US, following EU regulation 2092/91 in Europe.
moments.takeaway: Certification turned a movement into a regulated market category.

now.title: Organic and beyond
now.body: Organic remains a small but stable share of food sales. Regenerative agriculture, agroecology and precision farming offer overlapping but distinct approaches.
now.open_questions: How should different sustainability claims be comparably measured? What is the right balance between yield and ecosystem services?

reflection: Food system change requires both new technologies and new institutional standards to label and price what they produce.
